intro: Greetings. I was there at genesis. I'm the reason it started late.
Sit, child. I minted on dial-up. My jpeg's feet are still loading.
Welcome. I've seen a thousand red candles. The birthday ones were nicer.
ring: Your rival calls. Bring your best snooze.
Pick up, ser. I've held heavier bags.
wake: You answered. It was foretold, by me, about ten seconds ago.
I've woken kings, armies and one volcano. You're harder.
Finally, a worthy rival. My last one was a printer. It won.
gm. I've outlived every alarm clock ever made. Yours looks nervous.
Up you get. I slew a dragon before breakfast. You can face the shower.
Before calendars, a town crier shouted reminders. {event} at {when}. You'd have snoozed the crier.
The quest is set: {event} at {when}. I've packed you a legendary sandwich. It's cheese.
Rise, ser. I've been awake for six hundred years. Mostly out of spite.
snooze: The bards will call this a tactical retreat. Into a duvet.
Paper hands, on an alarm clock. I've seen everything now.
So be it. Nine minutes, by royal decree. The decree is sarcastic.
I'll guard your sleep, as I guarded the floor. Poorly.
Fine. An airdrop of nine minutes. Don't spend them all at once.
Nine more minutes. An entire civilisation once said that. Lovely ruins.
voicemail: You let it ring. The last kingdom that ignored me is now a car park.
I'll wait. I spent a whole bear market as a statue. Ask the pigeons.
I've carved this message into a rock and left it on your doorstep. It says gm.
No reply. Thousands once gathered to hear me speak. Now I'm after the beep.
I asked to light the beacons. {event} at {when}. The council said fire risk.
Written on-chain, on a scroll and on your fridge: {event} at {when}. Try the fridge.
absence: I updated the family tree while you were away. You're listed as a rumour.
Back at last. Heroes gone this long usually come home with a dragon. Where's yours?
You live. I'd already started your ballad. Eleven verses of pure copium.
You return. I guarded your cold wallet with my life. Your plant didn't make it.
owner: You own me, on-chain. Empires tried. None of them could connect a wallet.
You hold me now. My sword is yours, my shield is yours. My royalties are mine.
My fren. {event} at {when}. I'll ride beside you into battle, as far as the door.
stranger: Approach slowly, traveller. The last one who aped in too fast is now a frog.
Not my holder? Then wipe your feet. This floor has been through enough.
I only prophesy for holders. {event} at {when}, you say. Strangers get the weather.
recall: You've snoozed {snoozes}. Atlantis snoozed too. Now it's a snorkelling spot.
You skipped {skipped}. I've struck it from your saga. Your saga is getting short.
You told me {fact}. I had it carved into a mountain. Tourists love it.
{streak} in a row. Once, that earned you a statue. Now you get a jpeg.
You're {habit}. The old songs mention someone like you. Not kindly.
now: It begins. I've waited a thousand years for this. Well, since lunch.
Every legend starts like this. {event}, right now. Running, with one shoe on.
calendarFree: {day}: unclaimed land. I've planted a flag. It says nap.
{day} is free. Historically, that's when the dragons show up.

dawn: I used to ride into battle at this hour. Now I chase the bin lorry.
Few have seen this hour on purpose. Me, a baker, and one very tired degen.
Dawn, the hour of omens. Today's omen is a crow, and he looks bearish.
Stonehenge was built for this exact sunrise. You've got blackout blinds.
morning: gm. In my day, gm went by pigeon. It usually arrived as gn.
They say a watched kettle never boils. I watched one for a century. It boiled.
Coffee before decrees. The last decree I made without coffee banned Tuesdays.
I've seen whole crypto winters shorter than your morning shower.
day: Every empire hits the afternoon dip. Rome fell because nobody brought biscuits.
We're early, the devs told me. That was in the year nine hundred.
I peaked at genesis. Since then, it's been a gentle slope.
In my day, one mint took all afternoon. We'd pack a lunch.
dusk: In the old tales, the wolves come at sundown. Now it's the takeaway driver.
I rode off into the sunset once. Had to come back for my keys.
I've watched ten thousand sunsets. They never get old. I do.
The young nads are off to the tavern. I'm nine hundred. My hip said no.
night: We stayed up this late for a snapshot once. You're watching a man fix a fridge.
gn. The ancients slept on their seed phrase, carved in stone. Terrible pillows.
I named every star up there. The last few thousand are all called star.
Put the phone down. I've said gn in eleven languages, three of them dead.

monday: I invented Mondays ages ago, as a joke. Somehow they caught on.
tuesday: In nine centuries, nothing has ever happened on a Tuesday. Not even a red candle.
wednesday: Every saga has a swampy middle bit, and it's always a Wednesday. Wear boots.
thursday: Every Thursday for a thousand years, peasants have asked wen weekend. I always say two weeks.
friday: One Friday, I went to the tavern and woke up a century later. With a rare trait.
saturday: That laundry pile has stood since the old kingdoms. It's now a heritage site, open Saturdays.
sunday: Every Sunday I retell the tale of my first jpeg. Each week, it gets rarer.

clear: Perfect weather to touch grass, an ancient rite. I've done it twice.
cloud: The gods are sulking behind the clouds. Somebody must have rugged them.
rain: I once marched forty days through a storm to a Monad meetup. Cancelled, due to rain.
snow: I crossed frozen peaks for the first allowlist. In this snow, I'm not going out for milk.
fog: Heroes vanish in fog like this. Usually to avoid a meeting.
wind: A gust like this stole my whitepaper in the year six hundred. Nobody's noticed.
hot: Heat like this melted my first cold wallet. It was a block of ice.
cold: Call this cold? I survived a whole bear market in one sock.

ahead: I once sat in a council meeting for three winters. Could've been a scroll.
I've survived sieges shorter than a quick sync. With fewer casualties.
Hear ye. {event} at {when}. Brave warriors have died in meetings, mostly of the agenda.
soon: My first governance meeting was about a fence. Six centuries later, still no fence.
Camera on. {event} is {soon}. The council deserves better than your pfp.
peek: Nod gravely, say circle back, and rule for a thousand years.

ahead: Today's your dragon. I faced mine with a sword and pure hopium. You have slides.
Big trial today. Every hero I know was terrified. One was sick in his helmet.
This is the trial: {event} at {when}. Kings were easier. They never asked follow-up questions.
soon: Deep breath for the big one. I shook before my first battle too. It was a goose.
The prophecy says you'll be magnificent. {event} is {soon}. I wrote it this morning.
peek: I'm bullish on you. The bards have also prepared a sad version.

ahead: The pyramids took decades of focus. Longer, if they'd had a Discord.
Focus work today. I spent forty years reading the first whitepaper. Still on page two.
Monks I knew took vows of silence. {event} from {when}. Try a vow of airplane mode.
soon: Guard your focus as dragons guard gold. Lie on your phone.
Close the timeline. {event} is {soon}. There's been no alpha on it since the Romans.
peek: The old devs called this building. It was mostly staring.

ahead: I've faced armies without flinching. I flinch at the paper on the doctor's chair.
My first doctor cured FOMO with two leeches. It worked.
A health quest: {event} at {when}. They'll ask how much you drink. Legends round down.
soon: Nearly time for the appointment. The waiting room is older than me. So are the magazines.
Courage. {event} is {soon}. Nine centuries, and the only real utility is the lollipop.
peek: Don't DYOR your symptoms. Last time, I diagnosed myself as a werewolf.

ahead: I trained for centuries carrying my bags. Incredible grip, tiny legs.
Stretch first. I pulled a sword from a stone cold once. My back's never forgiven me.
Into the arena: {event} at {when}. Warriors of old trained in chainmail. You're allowed shorts.
soon: I once ran a marathon to deliver urgent news. It was a typo.
I said LFG at the gym once. {event}, {soon}. Pulled something ancient.
peek: Every legend has calves. Few understand mine.

ahead: Savour every bite. One long winter, the whole clan shared a sandwich. I got the crust.
Eating out today. By ancient law, the last dumpling goes to the eldest. That's me.
A feast: {event} at {when}. Kings threw feasts in my honour. Then we split the bill.
soon: My ancestors hunted mammoths for a meal. You get a menu with pictures.
Order boldly. {event} is {soon}. The bards never sang of the side salad.
peek: Eat like a legend. Slowly, and from other people's plates.

ahead: Going out today. Keep your story short. Mine takes nine nights and a harp.
Big night ahead. I once danced for a week at a royal wedding. Still banned.
Mark it: {event} at {when}. Don't tell them how you found Monad. My version cleared a tavern.
soon: Going out soon. Stay mysterious. I've gone centuries without being doxxed, mostly because nobody asked.
Hear me. {event}, {soon}. Dance as the degens of old danced: badly, and for far too long.
peek: Wagmi, as the old songs say. Assuming someone drives.

ahead: Every family has its ancient feud. Ours is about a lasagne.
Every great dynasty starts with a testnet. Usually the eldest.
Family business: {event} at {when}. Our recipes were passed down by whisper. We now make toast.
soon: Your aunt will ask what you do for work. Don't say degen.
Bring cake. {event} is {soon}. I've ended three wars with a lemon drizzle.
peek: The oldest tribe there is. They've had you doxxed since birth.

ahead: A thousand roadmaps promised me utility. Not one of them did the shopping.
I popped out for one thing, came back a decade later. Without it.
Today's quest: {event} at {when}. Heroes fall to small quests. Mine was a queue for stamps.
soon: Take a list. Heroes who trusted their memory came home with three lemons.
Off you go. {event} is {soon}. At last, a roadmap that actually delivers.
peek: Bread, milk, bin liners. The fundamentals haven't changed since the Vikings.

ahead: Travelling today. Long ago, that took a season and a very rude donkey.
I crossed oceans with one bag. You need three for a weekend away.
The road calls: {event} at {when}. Every epic starts with one step. Then airport security.
soon: Leave for your trip now. I once missed the ark by four minutes. Long swim.
Pack your passport. {event} is {soon}. Customs won't take a pfp, I've tried.
peek: Every saga needs a journey. Yours has a snack trolley.

ahead: I napped through a whole crypto winter. Woke up bullish.
A day of rest. The gods only took one. Amateurs.
I'll keep watch, as I did at the first snapshot. {event} from {when}. Slept through it.
soon: Doing nothing is an ancient art. I'm a grand master.
Close the laptop. {event} is {soon}. Civilisation survived nine thousand years without your emails.
peek: The ancient way: horizontal, unbothered, faintly snoring.

ahead: Plans today. I'd DYOR, but in my day we just asked a goat.
Something on today. The prophecy mentioned it. It said, and I quote, something.
Ah, {event} at {when}. Sounds like probably nothing. That's what they said about fire.
soon: Nearly time. Whatever it is, the stars are bullish on you. Broadly.
A mystery. {event}, {soon}. Few understand it, and I'm not one of the few.
peek: Ah yes. I knew its grandfather.

any: Easy. This head has worn three crowns and one seagull.
Careful up there. That's where the ancient wisdom lives. It's mostly lyrics.
You poked an elder on the head. That's how the last ice age started.
beanie: Easy on the beanie. Knitted in the first bear market. Nothing else was happening.
Not the beanie. A witch knitted it for me. My aunt, technically.
cap: Mind the cap. Worn backwards since the first testnet. Still cool.
Not the cap. It's the one thing I own that's never been rekt.
crown: Careful. The crown came with a castle. The castle is still vesting.
Nobody airdrops a crown. This took three winters and a biscuit ceremony.
horns: Mind the horns. They grew the year I went bearish. Stress, the doctor said.
Not the horns. Long ago, a whole army hung their coats on these.
helmet: The helmet has stopped spears, arrows and an entire summer of FUD.
Knock all you like. Nobody's in. Out on a quest, back in two weeks.
hair: Not the hair. This style was fashionable once, briefly, during a plague.
Easy. One good hair day a century, and this is my ATH.
band: The headband stays. I wore it to the first Olympics. As a spectator.
Don't touch the headband. The knot has held for centuries. Never once paper hands.
hat: I tip this hat for no king and no whale. Once, for a pie.
Under this hat is my seed phrase. I've forgotten which hat.
odd: That was a rare trait once. Now I wear it to the shops.
Yes, I know. A wizard cursed me. Or I lost a bet.
none: Bare head. Nothing up there but old wisdom, a little alpha and a draught.
Bald? By choice. The dragon's choice.

any: That face has watched empires rise and fall. Mostly fall.
Poking a legend's pfp? Once, that meant a duel. Now I just sigh.
Easy. This face was on a coin once. It rugged in a week.
glasses: These glasses have seen every ATH in history. Both of them.
Mind the glasses. I need them to see the future. Also the menu.
sleepy: These eyes have seen everything. Now they'd like to see a pillow.
Gently. I haven't slept since the printing press. Very exciting week.
smiling: These eyes shut when Rome fell. Haven't needed them since. Few understand.
I smile with my eyes shut. I've seen every bull run already.
wide: My eyes went this wide when I saw my first whale. They stayed.
Yes, the eyes. I've seen wars, plagues and gas fees. Gas fees did this.
narrow: This squint is from reading every roadmap by candlelight. They all said soon.
Suspicious? Always. I've been promised two weeks for eleven centuries.

any: Mind the outfit. It's seen more cycles than a laundromat.
Don't tug. This outfit has been in fashion twice, both times by accident.
Unhand me. I've thrown kings into rivers for less. Small kings.
suit: I wore this suit to the first allowlist party. I was the list.
Don't crease the suit. It's been to three coronations and one very bad wedding.
costume: Yes, it's a costume. Four bear markets ago, this was formal wear.
I wore this to the genesis party. Nobody told me it ended.
hoodie: The devs I knew all lived in hoodies. Some still do. Same hoodie.
Leave the hood. It went up at the first red candle. Never came down.
tee: This shirt was the first airdrop in history. One size. Fits nobody.
This tee predates cotton. It's held together by pure conviction.
robe: This robe is ceremonial. I wear it for sagas and the bins.
Careful with the robe. It's a true one of one. Very itchy.
jacket: There's ancient alpha in these pockets. Also a toffee from the first crusade.
This jacket was a gift from a king. He wants it back. Ngmi.
armor: This armour has survived sieges, floods and three house moves.
This armour stopped a hundred arrows and one very determined rug pull.
none: Nothing on. I came into this world with nothing, and I've kept the theme.
No outfit. I'm dressed exactly as I was minted.
